data.current_summary: List the singleton catalog for an organization
data.current_description: Report the singletons in the catalog, each with its installation state. A service token sees all of them (media-library, dashboard, workbench, agent, home, favorites, notifications, context, persona); a session token sees only the org-managed ones (context, persona), which is what an organization may turn on itself. Only singletons with an active deployment are returned. `name` narrows to a single singleton and `state` to one side of `installed`. `unavailableReason` says why the organization can't install a singleton (`ai-features-disabled`), or is `null`. The set is fixed, so the response is not paginated.
data.summary_suggestion: List available singletons with installation state
data.description_suggestion: Retrieve the catalog of available singletons for an organization, each with its installation state and availability status. A service token sees all singletons (media-library, dashboard, workbench, agent, home, favorites, notifications, context, persona); a session token sees only org-managed singletons (context, persona). Only singletons with active deployments are returned. Use `name` to filter to a single singleton and `state` to filter by installation status (installed/not installed). The response includes `unavailableReason` indicating why an organization cannot install a singleton (e.g., `ai-features-disabled`), or `null` if available. The catalog is fixed and not paginated.

data.current_description:
